name: 맥스파이시 상하이 버거

referenceVerification.method: Read official Korean menu description and visually inspected the rendered official product photo in the browser.
uncertainties: 공식 설명에서 100% 닭가슴살 패티와 쌀가루·양상추·토마토를 확인했다.
흰색 소스의 종류는 상품 사진에 기초한 관찰이며, 해당 상세 설명은 이름을 명시하지 않는다.

prompt:
Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: original generated food photo cutout for a burger tournament.
Primary request: one realistic Korean McDonald's McSpicy Shanghai Burger, modeled on the actual ingredient structure in the official Korean menu photo viewed at https://www.mcdonalds.co.kr/kor/menu/detail/603/5/16. Create a new original photographic depiction.
Subject accuracy: EXACTLY ONE large, fairly flat oval-round breaded fried CHICKEN BREAST fillet patty, golden orange, with fine crunchy rice-flour breadcrumb granules. It must look like a breast-fillet patty, not a beef patty, minced patty, two patties, or enormous ragged thigh fillet. Top-to-bottom visible stack from the official photo: lightly domed golden sesame-seed top bun; a little white mayonnaise under crown; generous pale-green shredded iceberg lettuce; bright red fresh tomato slice layer; single golden orange breaded chicken breast patty; toasted bottom bun. Standard compact fast-food burger proportions. Do not add cheese, pickles, onions, bacon, sweet dark glaze or beef.
Style/medium: realistic high-quality studio food product photograph, natural bread/vegetable textures, bright neutral softbox lighting, detailed crisp patty crust, matching a clean isolated fast-food burger product collection.
Composition: one complete assembled burger centered square canvas, nearly straight-on slight three-quarter angle with a little crown visible; fills about 85% of width but not cropped, clean margins on all sides.
Scene/backdrop: genuine transparent alpha background, no surface, subtle natural self shading only.
Constraints: no text, logos, watermark, packaging, plate, fries, drink, hands, props, extra burgers, exploded view or cutaway.

validation.visualInspection: 패티 개수·주요 재료·층 순서·로고/텍스트 없음·전체 버거 구도를 검수했다. 배경 후광이나 바닥은 보이지 않는다.
validation.note: AI 재현 이미지이며 실제 상품의 두께·형상·질감과 완전히 동일함을 보장하지 않는다.
